title: Art. 8 — Montreal Convention 1999, Chapter II - Documentation and Duties of the Parties Relating to the Carriage of Passengers, Baggage and Cargo, Article 8 — Documentation for Multiple Packages
theme: Documentation and Duties of the Parties
content: When there is more than one package: (a) the carrier of cargo has the right to require the consignor to make out separate air waybills; (b) the consignor has the right to require the carrier to deliver separate cargo receipts when the other means referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 4 are used.
